reddit.title: Improved Performance for Flowing Water in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant optimizations to how flowing lakes are processed in Provincia. By limiting the rescan area when a cell dries, we’ve reduced script time for a 64×64 lake from 20 ms to just 12 ms. This change enhances performance without compromising depth accuracy. Check out the full details on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
